name: Seedance Studio
summary: Cinematic prompt studio: film-grade character sheets, shot-by-shot storyboards, timed video prompts with or without dialogue, and five matching environments for one world, in your character's own style or one of ten styles.
use_when: The user wants a character sheet or turnaround from an idea or a reference image, a storyboard for a video idea, a timed video prompt with or without dialogue for Seedance or any video model, or backgrounds, environments, locations or sets for a character or a story: with or without a character image, matched to the character's look or in a style they pick (photoreal, anime, 2D cartoon, 3D animated, claymation, pixel art and more). Also when they want themselves in a video built from scratch, or a stylised version of themselves that Seedance accepts.
produces: Copy-ready prompts, each in its own code block: a film-grade character sheet; a shot-by-shot storyboard with the shot count and length the user picks; a timed video prompt with or without dialogue, under 2,000 characters; or five standalone JSON background prompts for one world (1 main location and 4 connected places, each with camera angle, framing, lens, lighting and a negative prompt), empty so characters can be placed in later. Every answer ends with a next step, so a character, its world, its storyboard and its video connect.
